meeting_density.caption: Team average meetings per person, by weekday and time block.

causal_categories.structural_fact: The team averages 3.5 meetings per person per day.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Review whether recurring meetings this week can be shortened or made async.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 39.6% of meetings are scheduled back-to-back with no gap.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Suggest adding buffer time between back-to-back blocks where possible.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 30.6% of meetings have no agenda attached.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Encourage agenda-required norms for recurring meetings.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 7.2% of meetings fall outside standard working hours.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Check whether after-hours meetings are avoidable for most attendees.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 31.2% of days have no contiguous midday break.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Consider protecting a midday buffer window on the team calendar.
